rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent compact mass with a clear dominant bent slab gesture and a secondary cantilevered segment, so gesture clarity and hierarchy are acceptable. Because the brief requires neighborhood living with an active ground threshold and one clear public void/court/terrace, this form presently behaves more like an abstract compact object than a program-responsive street building. References support the need for a clearer podium/void relationship and a more deliberate public threshold, but the candidate currently under-delivers on those program invariants.
